result.stdout:
Usage: cacademo [OPTION]...

Run libcaca demo effects. With no effect named, cycles through the whole
rotation in order. Name one effect to run it standalone, or name several
to cycle through just those, in the order given.

Effects:
  --plasma
  --metaballs
  --moire
  --langton  (not in the default rotation)
  --matrix
  --rotozoom

  --fps       show the achieved frame rate in the top right corner
  --list      list the effect names, one per line
  -h, --help  show this help
